parameters.query: SELECT supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE done_date <= required_date) AS ontime, AVG(NULLIF(quality_score,0)) AS quality, AVG(NULLIF(cooperation_score,0)) AS coop FROM supplier_tasks WHERE status = '已完成' AND done_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - interval '1 month') AND done_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY supplier_name

UPDATE suppliers SET ontime_rate = data.ontime, quality_score = COALESCE(data.quality, quality_score), cooperation_score = COALESCE(data.coop, cooperation_score), last_review_date = CURRENT_DATE FROM (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(supplier_name varchar, total int, ontime int, quality numeric, coop numeric)) AS data WHERE suppliers.name = data.supplier_name RETURNING suppliers.name
